pages.text: SYN Market Wire analyst note on Mwanga Insurance (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 38.49 for MWA3. The note cites steady demand in the insurance sector and cost control at Mwanga Insurance (SYN). Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter.
